add.title: LGBTQ people in prison - Wikipedia
add.summary: Thin for Belize: the article (fetched, HTTP 200) surveys how LGBTQ prisoners worldwide are affected by strip-searching, solitary confinement, a disproportionate-incarceration risk, and transgender placement debates (including the US context), but its only Belize mention is a 'Violence in Belize' navbox taxonomy link. It contains no Belize-specific practice: no birth-sex-vs-identity housing rule, no trans special units, and no solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners in Belize; no usable placement finding.
